concept: IAM: least privilege — Resource = ARN of a specific secret
tests: How to restrict an app to a single secret in an IAM policy.
expected: Action secretsmanager:GetSecretValue + Resource = ARN of the specific secret. Triggers: "specific secret but nothing else", "least privilege".
why_not: Resource "*" grants access to all secrets; secretsmanager:* and AdministratorAccess are grossly excessive permissions.
